tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi gser skyems bzhugs so/ /na mo padma karma ka ye na maḥ'adir rtsa gsum lha tshogs yul lha gzhi bdag
༄༅/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi gser skyems bzhugs so/ /na mo padma karma ka ye na maḥ'adir rtsa gsum lha tshogs yul lha gzhi bdag

tei:div.tei:p: $!#$&༄༅// rtsa gsum lha tshogs yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi gser skyems bzhugs so// na mo padma karma ka ye na maḥ

'dir rtsa gsum lha tshogs yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la gser skyems mchod par bya bar 'dod pas gtsang zhing rgya che ba'i mchod rdzas rnams 'du byas la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs la/ kyai/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus o rgyan rdo rje 'chang*// dbyer med snang srid zil gnon karma ka /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul bka' brgyud bla ma la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i gser skyems phud kyis mchod// 'khor lo bde mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*// gu ru drag po rdo rje gro bo lod// phag khros seng sogs yi dam lha tshogs la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i= /legs ldan nag po rdo rje ber nag can// phyag bzhi phyag drug gur mgon ma ning dang*// rang byung rgyal mo dud gsol lha mo la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i= /rgyal chen rnam sras klu rgyal sngags kyi bdag /mgar ba dmar nag srin mgon zhing skyong dang*// trakshad khyab 'jug mkhar nag dug gdong la// ye shes= /tshe ring mched lnga rdo rje g.yu sgron ma// chos kyi sgron ma arya re manta// rta bdag gnod sbyin chen po ku be ra// ye shes= /lha chen thang lha rma rgyal spom ra dang*// sku rgyal shen ne rdo rje brag btsan dang*// rdo rje rjing btsan byang lha btsan po la// ye shes= /rgya lha gang bzang gangs dkar sha med dang*// lag sor phyug mo khyor ba rtse gsum dang*// khung khyim zhal dkar g.ya' ma stag lag dang*// btsan rgod chen po jag pa me len la// ye shes= /sbrag btsan dbyi rgyal dpal ldan shes rab dang*/ rdo rje sman dpal gtsang rme nag phyi sogs// skye lha yul gzhi'i gnas bdag tshogs rnams la// ye shes= /rgyud srung ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan ma// sku lha ha bo gang bzang sras blon 'khor// shel ging dkar po tsi'u dmar po la// ye shes= /ma gza' dam can lha btsan thog rgod che// dge bsnyen padma btsun sras blon 'khor bcas// bka' sdod seng ge bon chung 'khol po kha// ye shes=

/gzhan yang yul phyogs 'dir gnas gzhi bdag dang*// lo zla zhag dus gza' skar spar sme'i lha// sa bdag rgyal blon phyogs skyong sde brgyad tshogs// gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur lhag rnams la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i gser skyems phud kyis mchod// mchod yul tshogs rnams mnyes shing tshim gyur nas// rgyal bstan spyi dang karma bka' brgyud kyi// bstan pa dar zhing bstan 'dzin zhabs pad brtan// 'jig rten khams kun bde skyid phun sum tshogs// kun kyang dkar po'i chos la spyod gyur cig /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon kun zhi tshe dpal 'byor pa rgyas// mi mthun 'gal rkyen phyi nang bar chad zhi// gzhi byas bya ba gang dang gang brtsam pa// legs kha rgyal kha thams cad bde blag tu// bsam don ma lus myur du 'grub par mdzod// khyad par gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi// chos srid mnga' thang gong nas gong 'phel zhing*// dge 'dun sde chen rab tu rgyas pa dang*// 'dus pa mthun zhing thos bsam bsgoms pa 'phel// tshe ring nad med 'byor pa rgyas par mdzod// sgrub brgyud snying po dpal ldan karma pa'i// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu la 'tshe zhing*// log par blta zhing bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi// gnod byed mi dang mi min gang yin kyang*// srung ma las mkhan pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis// srog chod snying phyungs ltas ngan sna tshogs thong*// ming rus rjes shul tsam yang med par mdzod// mdor na legs pa'i phun tshogs kun 'phel zhing*// mi mthun nyes tshogs ring bcil dus rtag tu// bkra shis bde legs snang ba 'bar gyur cig / ces pa 'di'ang rje dbon bstan pa rab rgyas nas bskul ba'i ngor karma pa bcu bzhi pas bris pa maṅga lam/ ༈ bstan srung dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas la gser skyems 'bul bar spro na/ 'bru sna chang phud gtsang ma sogs 'du bgyi la/ raṃ yam̐ kham̐/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ bhyoḥ padma 'byung gnas zhang btsun dar ma'i mtshan// khyung po stag sham rgyal ba ye shes dang*// bla chen mgon po stong dpon shes rab mgon// dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i// yum rkyang brgyud pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul lo// yi dam khro bo'i dbang po gshin rje gshed// dmar nag 'jigs gsum phyag rgya zil gnon dang*// bde mchog dgyes rdor rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal// rdo rje phag mo seng gdong khros ma nag /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs la// gser skyems= /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen srung mdzad cing*// dam ldan rnal 'byor bu gcig ma bzhin skyongs// 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mo la// gser skyems= /rang byung rgyal mo dud sol lha mo dang*// rtsa 'jibs dmar mo dmag zor rgyal mo sogs// zhi rgyas dbang drag sprul pa yang sprul la// gser skyems= /chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung ma dpal lha mo// tshe ring mched lnga a phyi chos kyi sgron// rdo rje g.yu sgron sman mo 'bum sde la// gser skyems= /chu srin gdong can khri sman mdog ldems dang*// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma dgu rnams dang*// dus bzhi lha mo dmag rgyal chen mo bzhir// gser skyems= /dbang phyug nyer brgyad brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// e ka dza ti sha za kha mo che// bka' gter skyong mdzad ma sring rgya mtsho la// gser skyems= /'dod pa'i khams rnams kun la dbang bsgyur ba// srid pa mo brgyud ma mo'i lha tshogs rnams// shes rab rang bzhin bstan skyong thams cad la// gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'bul lo// de ltar bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin dpag med pa// kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar ji bzhin du// 'bul 'di dgyes bzhes thugs dam gnyan po bskang*// bdag cag dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag che phra thams cad kun// mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i tshogs rnams zhi ba dang*// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams zhi ba dang*// 'go yams rims nad dus 'khrug mtha' dmag bzlog

/bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan phrin las rgya cher rgyas// 'jig rten khams kun bde ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces gser skyems mchod cing*/ bhyoḥ sems nyid phrin las rnam bzhi'i khyad par ni// sems las gud na med cing sems kyang med// don dam spros bral kha dog gzugs kyang med// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du rang gi sems// mthun par bstan pa'i zhi ba'i dpal lha mo// zhi mdzad zhi gyur zhi ba'i ngang tshul can// zhi ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog dkar mo shin tu brjid// kun tu zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi dgra dang nad rnams zhi bar mdzod// mthun par bstan pa'i rgyas pa'i dpal lha mo// rgyas mdzad rgyas gyur rgyas pa'i ngang tshul can// rgyas pa'i 'khor gyi bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog ser mo shin tu brjid// kun tu rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod// mthun par bstan pa'i dbang gi dpal lha mo// dbang mdzad dbang bsgyur dbang gi ngang tshul can// dbang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog dmar mo shin tu brjid// kun tu dbang mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi 'khor dang longs spyod dbang du bsdus// mthun par bstan pa'i drag po'i dpal lha mo// drag mdzad drag gyur drag po'i ngang tshul can// drag po'i 'khor gyi bskor ba'i gtso mo ni// rtags kyi sku mdog nag mo shin tu brjid// kun tu drag mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdag gi dgra dang nad rnams drag po'i sod// khyod kyi rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pa// 'di ltar mtshan nyid cir yang snang ba ni// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dren pa'i rtags// nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams brlag par mdzad// bdag kyang las bzhi'i rang bzhin lhun grub nas// khyod ltar gzhan gyi don la brtson gyur cig

/'gro ba sgrol ba'i mthu dang ldan par shog /de phyir mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'di bzhes la// thugs dam brgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces bstod/ sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod// dge 'dun sde skyongs rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel// snyan pa'i dar phyor grags pa'i dung 'bud la// 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod// rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas// mig la ya mtshan ltad mo dga' ba dang*// rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing*// dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral bar// zas skom 'byor pas ro 'dzin tshim byed cing*// lus la reg bya bde ba kho nas 'tsho// yid la rnam par bkra ba'i shes rab dang*// zag med bde bas nam yang ngom par mdzod// khyod gsol khyod bsten khyod mchod khyod rbad na// mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod// gzhi la bkra shis phun tshogs longs spyod ldan// byes su lam 'phrang chu la sgrol 'don mdzod// 'jigs sar dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs// mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la// 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam don lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la// tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs// don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par mdzod// dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'dir yang bkra shis shing*// nyin yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la// mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li// nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis bde legs shog

/gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'dod pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol ba dang*// chos srung yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyi// bdag sogs bsam don 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /bla ma dam pas byin gyis rlobs pa dang*// yi dam lha yis dngos grub stsol mdzad cing*// chos skyong srung mas bar chad zhi ba dang*// bstan pa dar zhing bkra shis chos 'phel bar shog / gis phrin las bcol zhing ji ltar bstod pa'i don thams cad smon lam rtse gcig tu bya'o// ces pa mtshur phu'i mgon khang sgrub pa po rnams kyis bskul ngor dpal karma pa bcu bzhi pa theg pa mchog gi rdo rje mdzad pa'o/ ༈ /bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i gser skyems 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bzhugs so// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ 'dod yon zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hrīḥ dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma dang*// zhi khro rab 'byams rgyud dang sgrub sde'i lha// dpal mgon lcam dral rgyud gsum srung ma'i tshogs// gser skyems mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub stsol// mi 'gyur bde chen chos dbyings bzang mo'i klong*// ma 'gags rang snang dbyings phyug dpal lha mo// gsang sngags srung ma bkra shis tshe ring ma// gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// dbyings kyi ma mo ye shes ḍakki'i gtso// zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i skur bstan lha sman rgyal// rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyong ba'i dam tshig can// gsol lo mchod do dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// mthu rtsal thogs med nyam pa'i snying 'byin ma// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che// stong gsum ma mo'i gtso bo tshe ring ma// gsol lo mchod do sangs rgyas bstan pa srung*// tshad med dbyings las rig bzhi lha mo'i tshul// mthing gi zhal bzang snang gsal pra yi bdag /mi g.yo blo bzang bcud ldan zas kyi bdag

/gsol lo mchod do rang rang dngos grub stsol// cod pan mgrin bzang bang mdzod nor gyi bdag /tal dkar 'gro bzang rkang bzhi phyugs kyi bdag /brtan ma bcu gnyis 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas// gsol lo mchod do rang rang dngos grub stsol// shes rab phar phyin rtag pa'i rgyal mo lnga// rnam 'gyur srung ma'i skur bzhengs lha mo lnga// ye shes las grub snang srid ma mor bcas// gsol lo mchod do dam las ma 'da' zhig /rgyu gnyis rkyen sbyar 'bru bcud snying po'i phul// 'chi med ye shes bdud rtsir sbyar ba 'dis// gsol lo mchod do bstan srung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// sku gsung thugs rgyud mnyes shing tshims gyur nas// rgyal ba'i bstan srung bstan 'dzin sku tshe bsring*// dge 'dun sde rgyas thos bsam sgom pa 'phel// mnga' ris bde zhing chos rgyal dbu 'phang mtho// phas rgol dgra dang nad mtshon mu ge med// lo legs 'bru 'phel skye dgu chos bzhin spyod// bod khams mtha' dbus kla klo'i 'tshe ba bzlog /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod rab 'byams las// gang bcol thogs pa med pa myur du sgrub// ces pa'ang lha ldan rtse mor spyi yi dad pa sel zhing kla klo'i 'tshe ba phyir bzlog pa dang 7skyabs mgon thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i zhabs pad kun tu brtan pa'i ched du gzhung sa mchog nas bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga'i rten rgyun gsar 'dzugs skabs nyer mkho'i cha rkyen du karma pa'i skye rab 'dzin pa bco lnga pa'i lhag bsam dag pas bris pa dge/ ༈ mgon po dang lha mo dam can gsum gyi ka bstod ni/ hūm̐/ ka dag 'dzin pa bral ba'i klong yangs nas// kha dog rab brjid dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra// gangs ri ltar rngams mche ba zangs g.yag gtsig /ngar 'dzin bstan dgra'i dpung tshogs ma lus rol// ca re gzigs pa'i nyi zla'i spyan mig g.yo// cha lugs gcig tu ma nges sna tshogs ston// ja chang khrag gis gtams pa'i thod pa 'dzin// nyams pa rtsad gcod gri gug mkha' la gdengs// ta tha ga ta'i bstan pa srung slad du// tha tshig gnyen po ma g.yel rjes su dgongs// dam tshig ldan pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag gis// na mar bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// pa sangs ltar dkar thod skam lnga yis brgyan// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs phyir rus brgyan spras// ba spu mtshon cha khro chung skar ltar 'khrugs// ma lus dbang du sdud mdzad khyod la 'dud// tsa ra mkha' lding shel nag spyi dkar dang*// tsha ba gsum sogs sbyar ba'i la du'i rdzas// dzab bzlas bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin mchod bstod sogs// wal ler dngos bshams yid sprul mchod rdzas dang*// zhag dang khrag gi mchod yon mtsho ltar bskyil// za ber g.yang gzhi ru mtshon sprin ltar gtib// 'a 'ur dung chen rkang gling rol mo'i sgra// ya mtshan mchod pa'i bye brag du ma 'bul// ra hu la sogs 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i bskor// las la thogs med rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// sha za srin po'i tshogs kyang 'dar byed pa'i// sa bcu'i dpa' bo khyed la bdag bstod do// ha ha'i gad mo'i sa gsum g.yo byed cing*// a ralli zhes bstan dgra'i dpung tshogs rnams// ma lus rol mdzad nag po chen po'i sku// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig

ces karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rjes khams dwang ba dang bcas rtse mo'i zhor du rang lo bcu gsum par bris pa'o// ༈ dzaḥbhyoḥ kā la de wi mkha' dbyings bde klong yum// kha dog mdzes sdug sna tshogs gar mkhan ma// gang zhig sgrub mchog skyong ba'i ma gcig gnyen// nga bdag dgra bo 'dul phyir 'dir gshegs nas// cang shes drel rta mi ro brjid pa'i khrir// chags med 'gro don mdzad phyir dgyes bzhugs nas// jag rkun bstan dgra'i 'tshe ba'i kla klo sogs// nyams pa bdun ldan snying khrag mchod yon rol// ta ler 'dzum pa'i zhal bzang bdag la ston// tha dad ma dmigs mchod sprin rnam mang yang*// dad mos gus pas spyan gzigs gcal du bkram// nad mtshon mu ge'i g.yul ngo zhi bar mdzod// pa ra mi ta bde gshegs dgyes pa'i yum// pha rol phyin ma nyid kyang bstan srung phyir// ba mchog bzhin du 'dod pa'i dpal yon 'jo// ma gcig lha mo rnam par 'phrul la bstod// tsā ri tra sogs nyer bzhi so gnyis kyi// tshal dang zhing skyong rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab// dza lang dgra bo'i ro zan shānti ma// wa spyang dred sogs cho 'phrul du ma'i tshogs// zhang zhung bon kyi srid pa'i rgyal mor 'bod// zab mo'i sngags kyi bstan srung ral gcig ma// 'a cag sgrub brgyud skyong ba'i re ma ti// ya mtshan dud pa'i sol ba mar yang grags// rang bzhin rtag pa'i rgyal mo mu kha le// lam mchog sgrub pa'i grogs cig g.yu yi sgron// sha za mkha' 'gro kun gtso tshe ring ma// sa gsum dbang ba'i mkha' 'gro khyod 'bod na// ha cang zhi bas mi thul lus me dpung*// ha li yi can bstan dgra sder bcas pa// a la la zhes bzhad pa'i gad rgyang gis// a don skye med klong du skad cig sgrol// rtag tu khyod mchod khyod bsten khyod 'bod na// dam tshig gnyer dgongs snying po'i bstan pa skyong*// 'jig rten bde zhing srid bzhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod//

ces mchod bstod phrin las bcol lo/ ༈ /dam can rdo rje legs par bstod cing phrin las bskul ba ni/ tri bhyoḥ kang ka dur bya 'khrigs pa'i tshal// khang brtsegs pha waṃ long bu'i mkhar// ga na pa ti rgyu ba'i gnas// nga rgyal dregs pa'i tshogs dbus nas// ca co 'bod pa'i gdung dbyangs dang*// cha lang rol mos spyan 'dren na// ja chang phud la dgyes rol phyir// nyams pa'i gshed ma rdo rje legs// ta la'i 'dab bzhin yangs pa'i 'phrul// thabs shes mched 'khor grangs med bcas// dam tshig gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang*// na tha'i g.yar dam rjes dgongs la// pags ri'i dar zab khri 'bol rtsegs// phas rgol snying khrag mchod yon bsgreng*// ba ra glang rta sha sna'i zas// ma lus mchod pa'i rdzas su sbyar// tsa ru'i bza' bca' ra skyes khyu// tsha gdung 'jigs skyobs go mtshon rigs// dza gad ja rgod 'bru sna'i phud// wa skyes klad 'gem seṅge sogs// zhwa thob 'od zhu ber lhab lhub// za 'og manḍa'i rin chen rigs// 'a zha'i yul gyi nyer spyod sogs// yangs pa'i khyon kun bkang ste 'bul// ra skyes gdong lnga dbang po'i khri// las byed mgar ba dmar nag mtshan// sha lang tho ba rlung gter bsnams// sa la gnas khyod bstod par bgyi// ha ha rgod sogs drag po'i gnas// gang du bzhugs kyang khyod 'bod na// a ti'i bstan la sdang ba'i dgra// skad cig brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod// de ltar rgyal ba'i bka' gnang nas// gang gi bka' 'bangs dharme dras// chos skyong zung la phrin bcol du// ka le'i phrin bang spel ste bris// de yis rgyal dbang karma pa'i// sku tshe mdzad phrin phyogs mthar khyab// bstan la 'tshe ba'i dgra sde'i dpung*// rmeng med zhi ba'i rgyur gyur cig /i shwa paṇye pas bris pa maṅga lam/// /
